svg.title: gpu profile
svg.text: 7 build arms, one nsys capture each
Fraction of each time bin in which the device was executing a kernel or a copy, from that arm's own capture. 900 bins
Tall bars are device work; the gaps are the device waiting on the host. This is structure, not duration: the span is
The 24 per-movie groups are visible as repeating dense clusters; the device is idle between and within them.

None of these changes alters kernel work (kernel union is 3.058 s base vs 3.061 s final). They remove host time and PCIe traffic, which is why the pattern compresses horizontally without getting denser.
